column3: “Complete” is rendered “count,” and “keepers of the threshold” as “doorkeepers.”
“Scroll” is rendered “book,” and “kindled in us” as “burns against us.”
“Keeper of the garments” is rendered “keeper of the wardrobe,” and “the second district” as “the Second Quarter”; NASB adds parentheses.
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned incense,” and NASB adds “therefore.”
“A horror” is rendered “a desolation,” and “also I have heard” as “I truly have heard you.”
